dataImport.title: Data Import
dataImport.description: Import your business data from CSV or Excel files to populate your account.

resetAllData.title: Reset All Data
resetAllData.description: This will permanently delete all appointments, customers, and services. This action cannot be undone.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account. This will cancel all appointments, remove all team members, delete your business and marketplace listing, and erase all data forever.
deleteAccount.irreversible: This action is immediate and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.subscriptionHint: If you have an active subscription, you must cancel it before you can delete your account.

subscriptionBlocker.title: Cancel your subscription first
subscriptionBlocker.message: You have an active subscription. To delete your account, please cancel your subscription first.
subscriptionBlocker.hint: After your subscription is cancelled (or scheduled for cancellation), you'll be able to delete your account.

instructionsEmailed.title: We've emailed you the next steps
instructionsEmailed.message: We've sent you an email with instructions on how to delete your account.

deleteAccountDialog.title: Delete account permanently?

bullets.teamMembers: Remove all team members from your business
bullets.businessData: Delete your business, services, and locations

deleteAccountDialog.irreversibleWarning: This cannot be undone. All data will be lost forever.
deleteAccountDialog.otherAccountsHint: If this email is also used as a customer or as a team member at another business, those accounts will be preserved.

leaveOrganisation.title: Leave Organisation
leaveOrganisation.cardDescription: Remove yourself from this business. You must cancel or reassign all your active appointments first.
leaveOrganisation.cardHint: Ask the business owner to reassign your appointments to another team member, or cancel them yourself.
leaveOrganisation.confirmMessage: You'll lose access to this business and everything connected to it — bookings, customers, and team data.
leaveOrganisation.confirmHint: This action is permanent. You'll need a new invitation to rejoin.
leaveOrganisation.successMessage: Your access to this business has been removed.
leaveOrganisation.successHint: We'll sign you out now. You can sign back in any time with another account or invitation.

activeAppointments.title: You still have active appointments
activeAppointments.message_one: There is 1 active appointment tied to your seat. Resolve it before leaving the organisation.
activeAppointments.message_other: There are {{count}} active appointments tied to your seat. Resolve them before leaving the organisation.
activeAppointments.hint: Cancel your pending appointments yourself, or ask the business owner to reassign them to another team member.
